flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi: NotificationSmsEmailJob + NotificationSmsEmailHelper (RD1 reminder candidates, combineNotices, template RD1_EMAIL_COMPANY, sendEmail, CorpPass contact refresh), EmailService (email.enableSmtp and email.smtp.allowedSources gate), FurnishApprovalHelper (hirer email from the furnish form), application-{dev,uat,prod}.properties and cron-schedules-prod.properties. Other repos: no relevant code. Only ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java is cited (the cronservice/ folder at the repo root is an old copy and is not used)
note: Status in stories.json: Demo paid (50% of 75%); demo_remark about Vault, email and the email permission for the App Service. This is the hirer version of OCMS11.10 (owner): the email flow for companies (id_type B) after the 1st letter exists and does not distinguish owner and hirer. Candidates are stage RD1, notices of the same company are combined per stage and due date, template RD1_EMAIL_COMPANY (or _COMBINED), and the email is sent per record through EmailService. Blockers in the repo configuration: (1) cron.notification.enabled=false in all environments; (2) in prod email.enableSmtp=false and email.smtp.allowedSources does not contain ENOTIFICATION (application-prod.properties:80-81), so EmailService refuses to send; uat contains ENOTIFICATION and dev has enableSmtp=true; (3) the email refresh from CorpPass DataHive is off (cron.enareminder.datahive=false), so the hirer email comes from the owner's furnish form. The email template text lives in ocms_template_store (DB): cannot verify from repo. Tickets as hints: OCMS-DF-2026-180 (Closed, waiting for the eNotification cron to be activated). Property values per environment in Azure, SMTP, DOS, and the email permission of the App Service: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Partial claim: the RD1 email flow for company hirers exists, but in the prod properties eNotification email and its cron are off and the template text cannot be verified from the repo

steps.step: OCMS gets the latest email address of the company hirer from the data source (DOS)
steps.detail: Companies are looked up in DataHive CorpPass by UEN (column CP_ACCOUNT_EMAIL, refreshCompanyContactInfo, NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2496-2530) and the new email is saved through updateOcmsCompanyContactInfo (2676-2705), called from NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:185-188. But refreshContactInfo only runs when cron.enareminder.datahive = 'true' (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2461-2485) and that property is false in dev/uat/prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:48), so the email stored in ocms_offence_notice_owner_driver is used. For a company hirer, that email is the one typed by the owner in the furnish form (FurnishApprovalHelper.java:552-558). Whether DataHive = 'DOS' in the story and the Vault permission (demo_remark): cannot verify from repo. Same as OCMS11.10 step 1.

steps.step: OCMS identifies the unique company hirers (UEN) and combines their outstanding NOPOs into one email
steps.detail: combineNotices uses the recipient key B_<UEN> + stage + due date, sums amount_payable and fills combinedNotices (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2151-2227; getRecipientKey 2230-2250; called at NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:191). Partial because the key includes the due date, so one company hirer with notices on different due dates receives more than one email. Same as OCMS11.10 step 2.

steps.step: Company hirers who opted out or have no valid email address do not get an email
steps.detail: UENs found in ocms_enotification_exclusion_list are skipped (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:226-231; the reminder query also drops them, NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1131-1134). validateContactInfo for id_type B only passes when the email is filled (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2259-2275); failed records are skipped (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:254-266). The exclusion list contents are DB data: cannot verify from repo. Same as OCMS11.10 step 3.

steps.step: The email lists the outstanding NOPOs and refers to the 1st letter reminder
steps.detail: For reminders, nextProcessingStage is filled with the last stage (RD1) (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:174-180) so determineTemplateName yields RD1_EMAIL_COMPANY or RD1_EMAIL_COMPANY_COMBINED (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:443-476); the template is split into subject and body (274-345) with data noticeNo, combinedNotices, noticeCount, amountPayable, paymentDueDate (410-437). The template text lives in ocms_template_store (DB), so whether it mentions the 1st letter reminder and lists the NOPOs: cannot verify from repo. Emails for stages DN1/DN2/DR3 are deliberately skipped because there is no template (313-316); not applicable to RD1. Same as OCMS11.10 step 4.

steps.step: The email is sent to the company hirers in a batch job
steps.detail: The job sends email only for id_type B (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:354) through sendEmail with source ENOTIFICATION (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:378-388; NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:556-590). EmailService refuses to send when email.enableSmtp=false unless the source is in email.smtp.allowedSources (EmailService.java:33-37, 65-72). Prod: enableSmtp=false and the allowlist has no ENOTIFICATION (application-prod.properties:80-81); uat: enableSmtp=false but the allowlist contains ENOTIFICATION (application-uat.properties:78-79); dev: enableSmtp=true (application-dev.properties:81-82). Plus cron.notification.enabled=false (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236). So under the prod configuration in the repo, the email to the hirer is not sent. The actual SMTP delivery and the email permission for the App Service: cannot verify from repo. Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-180 (Closed): the eNotification cron is waiting to be activated. Same as OCMS11.10 step 5.
